answer: Emerald cutter polished jewel warrant witnessed by the jewel charter turns identity into something scarce. Because each polished jewel is a year of appraisal tables in the guild ledger, so a farm must cut a hundred real emeralds by hand, the lantern of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the bridge first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The hollow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
